picks.headline: Report: EA's NHL 27 is using genAI for commentator voiceover, claims a sports broadcaster
picks.excerpt: Veteran commentator John Buccigross says EA demonstrated a system that clones his voice to generate in-game commentary lines. It would be one of the highest-profile uses of synthetic voice in a major sports franchise.
picks.rationale: EA가 NHL 27 중계 음성을 생성형 AI로 만든다는 증언이 나왔다 — 대형 스포츠 프랜차이즈의 합성 음성 사용 사례

picks.headline: Arm explains its mobile-first AI-reconstruction tech, a different tack from the "black box" approach of DLSS 5
picks.excerpt: Arm details a neural upscaling and frame-reconstruction stack built for mobile GPUs, positioning it against Nvidia's DLSS 5. "Our networks are not generative, so they're not of the same nature as the latest DLSS model," the company says.
picks.rationale: Arm이 재학습 가능한 공개 신경망 업스케일러를 모바일 GPU에 내놨다 — DLSS 5의 폐쇄형 접근과 정반대

picks.headline: A new ReShade addon offloads DLSS 5 neural rendering to a second GPU, slashing the AI filter's performance hit
picks.excerpt: Modders have built a ReShade addon that runs DLSS 5's neural rendering pass on a secondary graphics card. The workaround recovers most of the frame-rate lost to Nvidia's generative filter.
picks.rationale: 보조 GPU로 DLSS 5 뉴럴 렌더링을 떠넘기는 ReShade 애드온 — 성능 손실을 되돌리는 실제 기법

picks.headline: European game developers fear AI will pressure them to work faster more than they fear losing their jobs
picks.excerpt: A European games employment survey finds half of respondents worried AI will erode work quality, ahead of job-loss fears. 46% also say AI output makes it harder to assess a candidate's actual skills when hiring.
picks.rationale: 유럽 개발자 고용 조사가 AI 공포의 실체를 숫자로 보여준다 — 일자리보다 속도 압박

picks.headline: It's still possible to make good Skyrim mods "without any use of AI" in 2026, says the maker of a DLC-sized Black Marsh expansion
picks.excerpt: King of the Murkmire, a DLC-scale Skyrim expansion set in Black Marsh, shipped with its author stressing that no AI was used in its assets or writing. The release lands as AI voice and texture tools spread through the Bethesda modding scene.
picks.rationale: AI 없이 만든 DLC급 스카이림 확장 모드가 개인 제작자의 현재 가능선을 보여준다
